text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali calls for development of the telecommunications sector at a meeting with Communications Minister Habib Ammar.

- Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia is expected in Tunis on Friday. He tells the Tunisian press agency TAP in an interview: The relationship between the two countries is a model of good neighbourliness.
- Tunisia, Libya to connect power grid.
- Parliament adopts Industry Ministry budget for 1997.
- The Tunisian banking sector must play a role in modernising companies.
